lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: Lots of packages are arriving today, and lots of fake "receipts" are tagging along.

lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: Two new chapters are open: Harmful Files and Reading Logs. You also get the QUARANTINE action for devices that are already infected.

lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: Remember the difference: if a file hasn't been opened, just block it. If it was opened on an office laptop, quarantine the laptop.

lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: Your pay is looking pretty good. Drop by the Tool Shop: the Sandbox and Log Filter will help a lot.

lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: Nice work. Reading logs takes practice, and you're starting to see the patterns.

lines.speaker: kelabu
lines.text: Enough games. Tomorrow we're coming in person. Get ready, Nusa Digital.
